name: Market Trader Ceri

intro.text: Cockles, laverbread, bara brith! Hold on, a challenger. The cockles can wait. They're not going anywhere. They're cockles.

win: Duw, you're good. Have a Welsh cake for the road. Not that one, that's mine.
after: Penclawdd cockles, Gower salt marsh, the best in the world. Ask anyone in the market. Ask anyone who isn't from Penclawdd, even.
